question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 晴天時，我們看到太陽大致從哪個方位升起？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 地球自轉使我們觀察到太陽東升西落的視運動。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 誤以為太陽真的繞著地球轉一圈。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 同一根直竿在晴天中午時，影子長度通常如何？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 中午太陽高度角較大，影子較短。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 誤以為太陽越大顆影子就越長。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 太陽在西方接近地平線時，直立竿子的影子主要朝向哪裡？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 影子方向與太陽方位相反，太陽在西則影子朝東。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 誤以為影子會跟太陽同一邊。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 月亮盈虧變化大約多久完成一個週期？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 月相週期約 29.5 天。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 把公轉週期與自轉搞混。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 一般所說的月相變化，主要是因為什麼原因？
options: 月球公轉與日照角度改變
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 我們看到月亮亮面比例隨月球公轉改變。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 高頻迷思：把一般月相誤當成月食。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 在北半球可利用哪一顆星協助找到正北方位？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 北極星幾乎位於北方天空固定位置。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 誤以為最亮的那顆就是北極星。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 要在操場記錄竿影長短變化，下列哪一項最適合當控制變因？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 要比較時間造成的影長變化，竿長與位置應固定。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 把操作變因與控制變因顛倒。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 同一晚觀察星星，星星看起來會如何移動？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 地球自轉造成星空視運動。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 誤以為星星繞北極星公轉一圈只需幾分鐘。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 不同季節在同一時刻看到的星座常不一樣，主要與何者有關？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 地球公轉改變夜間面向的星空方向。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 誤以為只是天氣好壞造成。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 日晷主要是利用什麼來判斷時間？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 太陽位置改變使影子改變，可用來估算時刻。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 誤以為日晷靠太陽顏色判讀。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 滿月時，月亮、地球、太陽的大致位置關係為何？
options: 地球在月亮與太陽之間
月亮在地球與太陽之間
太陽在地球與月亮之間
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 滿月時地球位於中間，月球亮面朝向地球。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 與月食位置關係混淆。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 陰雨天無法看到月亮時，觀測日記應如何記錄？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 天候不佳應誠實記錄無法觀測，而非推測。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 把「看不到」誤當成「月亮消失」。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 小華面向北方站立，上午太陽在東南方天空，他的影子大致朝向？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 影子與太陽方位相反，朝西北延伸較合理。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 誤把身體面向當成影子方向。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 下列哪一項最適合描述「月食」？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 月食是地球影子落在月球上，與一般月相成因不同。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 把月食與月相變化混為一談。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 星座圖上相鄰的星星在實際宇宙中一定如何？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 星座是人為連線，星星距地球遠近差很多。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 誤以為同一星座的星真的聚在一起。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 毛細現象較容易出現在什麼條件？
options: 細小縫隙或孔隙的材料
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 水能沿細縫上升，需要可滲水的微細結構。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 誤以為任何材質放入水中都會吸水上升。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 相同液體中，細玻璃管與粗玻璃管相比，毛細上升高度通常？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 管徑越細，毛細現象越顯著。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 直覺誤以為粗管能吸更多水所以升更高。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 底部相通的靜止液體，各管液面最後會如何？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 連通管原理：靜止時同一液體液面等高。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 誤以為容器形狀會改變平衡高度。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 茶壺壺嘴高度若低於壺內最高水面，最可能發生什麼？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 連通管水面等高，壺嘴太低會先溢出。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 不理解壺身與壺嘴的連通關係。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 虹吸成功的關鍵條件之一為何？
options: 出水端低於入水端液面
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 虹吸仍靠重力，出口要低才能持續流出。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 誤以為虹吸是「水自己往上爬」。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 開始虹吸前，軟管內最好先如何處理？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 管內充滿液體並排氣，重力才能連續拉動水流。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 忘記排氣導致中斷。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 毛巾一端浸入水盆，水沿毛巾往上擴散，最適合稱為？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 纖維間細縫使水上升，屬毛細現象。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 與連通管「液面等高」混淆。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 下列哪一種較不利於觀察到明顯毛細上升？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 塑膠片孔隙極少，幾乎無毛細上升。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 誤以為所有固體都會吸水上升。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 想用虹吸把高架水桶引到低處花盆，下列哪項錯誤最致命？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 出水口若高於水源液面，重力無法維持流動。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 忽略高低差方向。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: U 形管兩側直徑不同，靜止後同一液體液面？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 連通管與管徑無關，靜止液面等高。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 被「粗細」直覺誤導。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 根部吸收的水分能往上輸送，常與下列何者機制有關？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 細胞間隙與木質部形成細小通道，類似毛細。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 誤以為水只會往下流。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 「底部相通、靜止液面等高」最符合哪一個概念？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 連通管強調底部連通與液面等高。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 三種水的移動方式混淆。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 觀察毛細現象時，為了公平比較不同材質，應保持？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 控制變因一致才能比較材質差異。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 同時改變多個變因。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 虹吸進行到一半停止，最常見的原因之一是？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 氣泡破壞連續水柱，重力鏈中斷。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 誤以為與管透明度有關。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 自動澆水裝置常結合虹吸，主要是利用？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 虹吸仍由重力驅動，出口要低。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 以為不需高低差也能虹吸。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 昆蟲身體最正確的分段描述是？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 昆蟲典型為頭胸腹三段體。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 漏掉胸部或與蜘蛛混淆。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 昆蟲的腳共有幾隻？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 昆蟲具三對足，共六隻，且著生在胸部。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 把蜘蛛的八隻腳誤套到昆蟲。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 下列哪一種「不是」昆蟲？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 蜘蛛屬蛛形綱，八隻腳，不符合昆蟲特徵。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 以外觀「像蟲」就誤判。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 昆蟲頭部的一對觸角，主要屬於什麼構造？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 觸角具嗅覺、觸覺等感覺功能。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 誤把口器或腳當觸角。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 完全變態的生活史，一定包含下列哪一階段？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 完全變態：卵→幼蟲→蛹→成蟲。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 把不完全變態與完全變態搞混。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 蝴蝶的幼蟲階段，外型與成蟲相比通常？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 完全變態幼蟲與成蟲形態差異大。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 不相信毛毛蟲與蝴蝶是同種。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 蝗蟲的不完全變態，幼期稱為？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 不完全變態：卵→若蟲→成蟲，無蛹期。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 把若蟲誤稱為幼蟲或不區分。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 要判斷「蚊子」屬於哪一類變態，最合理的配對是？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 蚊子有幼期與蛹期，屬完全變態。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 以體型小就誤判為不完全變態。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 沒有翅膀的成蟲（如跳蚤）仍可能是昆蟲，因為？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 昆蟲判斷以頭胸腹、六足、一對觸角為主。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 誤以為「有翅才算昆蟲」。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 蟋蟀與蝴蝶在變態類型上的差異，關鍵在於？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 蟋蟀不完全變態沒有蛹；蝴蝶有蛹期。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 只看外型大小判斷變態。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 觀察昆蟲時，為了安全與保育，較適當的態度是？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 尊重生命，避免傷害與過度捕捉。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 把昆蟲當玩具摔打。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 「身體分頭胸腹、六隻腳、一對觸角」可用來初步判斷？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 此為昆蟲主要外部特徵組合。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 把蜈蚣多足誤當昆蟲。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 記錄完全變態昆蟲時，下列哪一欄「不應」出現在正常發育序列？
options: 蛹期之後又出現幼蟲期
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 正常順序卵→幼蟲→蛹→成蟲，不會蛹後回到幼蟲。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 階段順序記錄錯亂。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 不完全變態的幼期稱「若蟲」，主要外型特徵是？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 若蟲外型近似成蟲，僅體型與翅未成熟。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 把若蟲與毛毛蟲型幼蟲混談。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 昆蟲在食物鏈中常扮演何種角色？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 多數昆蟲以植物或其他生物為食，屬消費者。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 誤以為昆蟲行光合作用。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 下列哪一項較屬「可再生」能源？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 太陽能在人類時間尺度可持續取得。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 誤以為「很大」就等於可再生。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 石油與煤炭相對太陽能，主要差異是？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 化石燃料屬不可再生，形成需數百萬年。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 低估形成時間尺度。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 隨手關燈主要可以減少什麼？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 減少用電可降低能源消耗與相關排放。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 不知道關燈與用電量的關係。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 把寶特瓶送到回收體系再製，較接近哪一個概念？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 回收再製屬回收（Recycle）。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 把回收與重複直接使用（再利用）混淆。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 環保行動中，「減少一開始的使用量」通常優先於？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: Reduce 減量優先於僅依賴回收。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 以為多回收就等於最環保。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 人類生活所需的水與能源，主要來自何處？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 我們依賴環境中的水循環與能源轉換。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 誤以為資源取之不盡。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 風力發電相對燃煤發電，較常強調的優點是？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 風力屬可再生，減少燃煤的燃燒與排放。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 誤以為再生能源零成本、零限制。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 下列哪一項屬於日常節水的做法？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 限量用水避免長流。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 認為水永遠用不完。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 舊牛仔褲改成購物袋繼續使用，較接近？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 同物品換用途屬再利用（Reuse）。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 把再利用誤叫成回收。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 大量消耗化石燃料，與下列哪項環境議題較相關？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 燃燒排放二氧化碳等溫室氣體。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 不理解能源使用與氣候的連結。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 電池常需特別回收，主要原因之一是？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 避免重金屬等汙染環境。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 把電池當一般垃圾丟棄。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 水力發電利用水從高處往低處流動的能量，屬於？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 水循環補充水源，屬可再生利用方式。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 誤以為水用完就消失永不回來。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 要同時達到「減少垃圾量」與「重複使用」，最佳起手式是？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 源頭減量與重複使用並行。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 只靠末端回收卻不改習慣。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 「隨手可開的風力與太陽能」仍可能受限於？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 再生能源也受日照、風力等條件影響。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 誤以為隨時同等功率。

question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.question: 為何要推廣資源回收與節能？
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.explanation: 資源與環境承載有限，需永續管理。
question/platform/G4/Science/S2/KangHsua.commonMisconception: 短視近利忽略長期影響。
